title: King and Pawn
description: The classic king-and-pawn endgame. Promote the pawn — your king guards the queening square — then mate.

title: Rook Endgame
description: King and rook versus king. Use the rook to cut off the back rank while your king takes the opposition.

title: Zugzwang
description: No check works yet. Make a quiet king move — Black is in zugzwang and must step into the mating net.
